verdict.rationale: Partial: NVIDIA claims much higher FPS through DLSS Multi Frame Generation (up to five generated frames per rendered frame), path tracing and Reflex low latency. Tom's Hardware's independent review backs the headline by calling it the 'fastest GPU around (usually)'. It also warns that MFG-driven high FPS only samples input at the base rate (240 FPS shown vs. 60 FPS of input), so the vendor's frame-rate claims overstate native responsiveness. missing for 10: specific independent 4K game frame-rate benchmarks, native high-refresh 4K results without frame generation, independent figures checking the vendor's MFG and path-tracing performance claims.
